answer: A new identity earns nothing until it proves it can judge. It starts in a lagoon, a holding pool with zero earning rights. Each epoch its private inlet queue delivers 6 answers to grade, 2 of them anchor items whose true score the network has already fixed. The seat leaves the lagoon only after 4 straight epochs matching both anchors within one point. So every fake pays 24 real judgment runs before its first reward, even if never caught; 500 fakes cost 12,000 runs. Queues differ per seat, so one grader's work can't be copied across a farm.
